observations: Photo 1 shows a Western Digital WD Scorpio Blue label with model WD2500BEVT and 250 GB capacity printed on it.
Photo 0 and photo 2 show multiple 2.5 inch laptop hard drives stacked and fanned out on a blue cloth.
All visible drives have WD branding and SATA connectors.
A watermark reads POSTED ON JIJI JERRY IDOKO across the images.

claims.evidence: photo 1 label reads 250 GB and model WD2500BEVT
photo 1 shows a 2.5 inch laptop drive form factor; model WD2500BEVT is a 2.5 inch drive

risks.risk: Drive may not power on or may have bad sectors
risks.proof: video of the drive connected to a computer, detected in BIOS/Device Manager, with a SMART health report

risks.risk: SATA connector or PCB may be damaged
risks.proof: close-up photo of the SATA data/power connector and circuit board

risks.risk: Drive may contain previous owner's data
risks.proof: seller confirmation or screenshot showing the drive has been securely wiped

proof_requests: Video of the drive spinning up and being recognized by a computer
Screenshot of SMART health status (e.g., CrystalDiskInfo)
Close-up photo of the SATA connector and PCB
response.reason: The model WD2500BEVT is clearly readable in photo 1, confirming a 250 GB 2.5 inch WD Scorpio Blue drive; functionality cannot be verified from photos so it is priced as not working.
